structured_output.summary: Child 3 is 10. Household MAGI is $60,010, about 182% of the 2026 HHS guideline of $33,000 for a family of four. That is above Pennsylvania's Medicaid limit for children and within its CHIP income limit. The prompt says Child 3 has employer-sponsored insurance all year. Under 42 U.S.C. 1397jj(b)(1)(C) and 42 CFR 457.310(b)(2)(ii), a child covered by a group health plan is not a targeted low-income child, so Child 3 is not CHIP-eligible (0). The engine applied the same test as stage 1. The consensus models that answered 1 checked age and income only and skipped the no-other-coverage condition, which is a condition of eligibility, not of enrollment.
